senses.gloss: m., constr. קְנֵי = h. קָנֶה, reed, stalk, branch, &c.
units: Targ. Ps. LXVIII, 31 (some ed. קָנַיָּא pl.).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 19:6">Targ. Is. XIX, 6</cite> (ed. Lag. <he>קנה</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Kings 18:21">Targ. II Kings XVIII, 21</cite>.—
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 40:3">Targ. Ez. XL, 3</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 41:8">Ib. XLI, 8</cite> (not <cite ref="S01570"><he>קָנַיָא</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 25:31">Targ. Ex. XXV, 31</cite> (ed. Vien. <cite ref="S01533"><he>קְנַה</he></cite>); a. fr.—

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 6:3">Lev. R. s. 6</cite> <he>נטל חד קנה וכ׳</he> he took a cane and made a cavity in it into which he put those Denars; <he>א״ל צור הדין ק׳ בידך וכ׳</he> he said to him, hold this cane in thy hand while I am being sworn; <he>נסתיה לקָנֵיה וכ׳</he> he took his cane and knocked it to the ground &c.; <cite ref="Nedarim 25a:6">Ned. 25ᵃ</cite> (the same occurrence before Raba).
<cite ref="Nedarim 25a:6">Ib.</cite> <he>לאפוקי מק׳ דרבא</he> to prevent such an occasion as occurred before Raba; <cite ref="Shevuot 29a:11">Shebu. 29ᵃ</cite>.

<cite ref="Chullin 111a:2">Ḥull. 111ᵃ</cite> <he>ק׳ בקופיה</he>, v. <cite ref="S00490"><he>קוֹפָא</he> II</cite>; a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="S01587"><he>קָנִין</he></cite>, <cite ref="S01570"><he>קָנַיָּא</he></cite>, <cite ref="S01570"><he>קָנֵי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 25:33">Targ. Ex. XXV, 33</cite>. Targ. II Esth. I, 2; a. e.—
<cite ref="Chullin 53b:8">Ḥull. 53ᵇ</cite> <he>על לביני ק׳</he> went among the reeds.
<cite ref="Chullin 45b:7">Ib. 45ᵇ</cite> <he>תלתא ק׳ הוו</he> there are three branches (of the windpipe), one branches off towards &c.; a. e.
